abstract: INTRODUCTION: Malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (MOGCTs) are highly chemosensitive tumors most commonly found in adolescent girls and young women. However, patients with advanced disease can now be successfully cured with fertility-sparing surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy, resulting in childbearing. CASE: A 24-year-old nulliparous Japanese woman was diagnosed as having a stage IIIc immature teratoma. After fertility-sparing surgery, she received four cycles of chemotherapy consisting of cisplatin, etoposide, and pepleomycin. She married at the age of 34, but did not conceive due to sexual dysfunction of her husband. At the age of 38, intrauterine insemination was performed following ovulation induction with clomid and human menopausal gonadotrophin, which resulted in a singleton pregnancy. A healthy female infant was delivered at 38 weeks' gestation. CONCLUSION: Treatment might sometimes be needed for infertile women with a history of MOGCTs, but further studies are needed to determine whether infertility treatment, including ovulation induction, is appropriate.
abstract_ja:
序論：悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(MOGCT)は、化学療法感受性の高い腫瘍で、思春期の少女や若年女性に最も多くみられる。しかし、進行例でも妊孕性温存手術と補助化学療法により治癒可能となり、妊娠・出産につながるようになった。
症例：24歳未経妊の日本人女性が病期IIIcの未熟奇形腫と診断された。妊孕性温存手術後、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ペプロマイシンによる化学療法を4コース施行した。34歳で結婚したが、夫の性機能障害のため妊娠に至らなかった。38歳時に、クロミフェンとヒト閉経期ゴナドトロピンによる排卵誘発の後、人工授精を行い、単胎妊娠となった。妊娠38週で健康な女児を分娩した。
結論：MOGCTの既往がある不妊女性には治療が必要な場合があるが、排卵誘発を含む不妊治療が適切かどうかはさらなる研究が必要である。
